mapper.select: SELECT gp.* FROM gld_period gp WHERE gp.PERIOD_SET_ID = #{periodSetId} AND gp.START_DATE >= (SELECT gp1.START_DATE FROM gld_period gp1 WHERE gp1.PERIOD_SET_ID = #{periodSetId} AND gp1.PERIOD_YEAR = #{startYear} AND gp1.PERIOD_MONTH = #{startMonth}) AND gp.END_DATE <= (SELECT gp2.END_DATE FROM gld_period gp2 WHERE gp2.PERIOD_SET_ID = #{periodSetId} AND gp2.PERIOD_YEAR = #{endYear} AND gp2.PERIOD_MONTH = #{endMonth})

select t1.* from ( SELECT t.period_name FROM gld_period t,gld_period_set s where s.period_set_id = t.period_set_id and s.enabled_flag = 'Y' and t.period_name>'2022' GROUP BY t.period_name)t1
